record.question: _____________ I am dead, my dearest, sing no songs for me. Complete the sentence by supplying appropriate connecting word.
record.explanation: Answer B: When. The line begins “When I am dead, my dearest”; when expresses the time at which the song instruction applies. Independent check: The quoted poetic instruction uses “When I am dead” for its time clause.
